index.title: EternalMonitor: your iPad as a second screen for your Windows PC
index.description: Mirror your Windows PC or add the iPad as a real second screen, over USB or Wi-Fi. Apple Pencil, touch and keyboard go back to the PC. Free and open source.
lang.label: Language
index.hero.title: Your Windows PC, on your iPad.
index.hero.lead: Mirror it, extend it, draw on it with Apple Pencil.
index.stage.label: The Windows app streaming over USB or Wi-Fi to the iPad, which shows the PC's picture
index.stage.pcAlt: The Windows app streaming to an iPad over USB, mirroring the screen at 60 fps, with the connected iPad's details, Send feedback and a GitHub star card in the sidebar.
index.stage.ipadAlt: The iPad showing the PC's picture full screen.
index.features.title: Features
index.mode.title: Mirror my screen, or a real second screen.
index.mode.mirrorAlt: The Windows app with Use the iPad as set to Mirror my screen: the iPad shows the same picture as your main screen.
index.mode.secondAlt: The Windows app with Use the iPad as set to Second screen: the iPad becomes an extra screen next to your main one.
index.picture.title: Fit the picture, or fill the iPad.
index.picture.fitAlt: The iPad app with Picture set to Fit: the whole PC picture, with black bars where the shapes differ.
index.picture.fillAlt: The iPad app with Picture set to Fill: the PC picture covers the whole iPad screen.
index.pencil.title: Apple Pencil, like a real pen.
index.pencil.text: Pressure and tilt, tuned with care, because we care about drawing.
index.pencil.alt: The iPad app's settings: how touch controls the PC (tap to click, drag to move, two fingers to scroll, hold to right-click), what the Command key acts as, and the Apple Pencil Drawing mode switch with its explanation.
index.pair.title: USB or Wi-Fi. Pair once.
index.pair.text: Or scan the QR code and skip the code.
index.pair.qrAlt: The Windows app's Scan to connect dialog, with a QR code and the PC's address under it.
index.pair.ipadAlt: The iPad app's Pair with your PC sheet, with a six-digit code field, a Pair iPad button and the number keyboard.
index.gpu.title: Your graphics card does the work.
index.gpu.text: NVIDIA, AMD or Intel, in H.264 or HEVC.
index.gpu.alt: The Windows app's Performance page: capture, encode and send rates, bandwidth, and a chart of encode time per frame.
index.feedback.title: Send feedback from either app.
index.feedback.text: One-click updates on the PC. The iPad updates through TestFlight.
index.feedback.alt: The iPad app's settings: Send feedback, Check for updates automatically, and About with the version, source code, Star EternalMonitor on GitHub and Contact.
index.numbers.label: In numbers
index.numbers.footnote: *On iPads with ProMotion. The lower of the PC's and the iPad's frame rate wins.
index.how.title: Three steps.
index.how.step2Text: Tap your PC, scan its QR code, or plug in a cable.
index.how.step3Text: Type the six-digit code the first time on Wi-Fi. The QR code skips it.
index.get.title: Two apps, both free.
index.get.windowsText: It isn't code-signed yet, so Windows asks before it runs.
index.get.usb: For USB: Apple's free <0>Apple Devices</0> app (Windows 10 22H2 or 11)
index.get.ipadText: A public TestFlight beta, open to everyone.
index.get.pencil: Apple Pencil for pressure and tilt
index.faq.title: Before you install
index.faq.free.a: Yes. Free, open source under MIT, with no account.
index.faq.mac.q: Does it work with a Mac?
index.faq.mac.a: No, the PC app is for Windows. Macs have Apple's <0>Sidecar</0>.
index.faq.usb.a: Wi-Fi to start. A cable gives a steadier picture and charges the iPad; it needs Apple's free Apple Devices app open on the PC (Windows 10 22H2 or 11).
index.faq.encrypted.a: Not yet. Pairing keeps other devices out, so use a network you trust. Over a cable, the stream stays on the cable.
index.faq.ipads.a: An iPad with iPadOS 17 or later. Apple Pencil (USB-C) has no pressure sensor, so its strokes keep one width.
index.faq.data.q: Does it send anything to you?
index.faq.data.a: Yes, diagnostics while the apps run: device details, errors and stream stats, including PC and iPad names, audio device names and network addresses. Never your screen, audio or pairing codes. Kept up to 30 days, sometimes less, and up to 7 more days in backups. Turn it off in Settings. <0>Details</0>.
index.faq.broken.a: See <0>known issues</0> and the <1>setup guide</1>, or <2>tell us</2>.

download.title: Download EternalMonitor for Windows and iPad
download.description: Get the EternalMonitor Windows installer and the iPad app from TestFlight. Free and open source. Tell us what you think.
download.heading: Download
download.lead: Install the Windows and iPad versions listed below. These versions work together even when their version numbers differ. Stuck? The <0>setup guide</0> has every step.

download.unsigned: Not code-signed yet: on <0>Windows protected your PC</0>, click <1>More info</1>, then <2>Run anyway</2>. The SHA-256 above lets you check the file.

download.ipad.stepsLabel: How to install on the iPad
download.ipad.step1: Install <0>TestFlight</0> from the App Store on your iPad.
